name: Smoked Salmon Salad with Egg, Roasted Sweet Potato & Pistachios
instructions: Wash, dry, peel, and small dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until sweet potato is fork-tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve eggs and transfer to a large plate.
Cut or tear salmon into bite-sized pieces and add to the plate with the eggs.
Peel, halve, and slice shallots into thin half-moons; add to the plate.
Roughly chop pistachios, add to the plate, and set aside.
Wash and dry mixed greens. (Skip this step if they came pre-washed.)
To serve, divide mixed greens, shallot, salmon, roasted sweet potato, pistachios, and eggs between plates. Drizzle with vinaigrette and enjoy!
author: Mealime
